_comment: Rule-based and statistical assessment settings (B1 THI band, A1 growth trend, A2 pen thermal flag). These are NOT trained models. null = not supplied yet: the component returns status not_configured instead of guessing. Wording lives in labels.json. PROPOSED VALUES (2026-10-19): THI formula and Grower/Finisher thresholds are sourced; growth values are starting defaults and design choices, not published standards. All need team and adviser approval.

formula.source: Vermeer & Aarnink (2023), EURCAW-Pigs review on heat stress in pigs on farm, section 4.1, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7620726. The same relation reproduces the THI values in PIC Wean to Finish Guidelines 2019, Figure 8.1 (all but 2 of 410 table cells within 0.75 THI; the 2 outliers within 0.85, consistent with rounding).

thi._categories_comment: Category names reuse the stage names from lib/features/pig_management/domain/model/app_pig.dart. thresholds = ascending list with len(band_keys)-1 values: THI >= thresholds[i] enters band i+1. hysteresis = how far THI must fall below a threshold before the band drops (rises are immediate). Grower and Finisher use the Livestock Weather Safety Index boundaries in PIC 2019 Fig. 8.1 (Alert from 75, Danger from 79; Emergency from 84 is not a separate band here). Piglet, Nursery and Mature are left null because no category-specific source was found and these thresholds would misclassify them.

growth.exclude_records_with_notes_basis: firestore_pig_repo.dart addPig() writes a hard-coded 1.4 kg 'Birth weight' entry for every pig (REPO_AUDIT.md G8); it is not a measurement. Empty this list once that is fixed.
growth.pen_comparison_min_pigs_basis: structural: a median comparison needs at least two pigs

benchmark._comment: Optional file, not in the repo. Display-only; never used by any flag or status. The supplied CSV names its weight column expected_kg, so weight_kg maps to expected_kg here.

basis.mad_scale: 1.4826 makes MAD a consistent estimator of the standard deviation for normal data
basis.mad_floor_c: AMG8833 output resolution 0.25 degC; stops a zero MAD giving infinite z
basis.time_of_day_block_hours: null = do not condition on time of day; e.g. 6 = four blocks per day
